commands: python -m parc_track.cli trackeval grid --dataset OVT-B --output-dir outputs/phase5_trackeval
python -m parc_track.cli trackeval grid --dataset TAO --output-dir outputs/phase5_trackeval
caveats: OVT-B export is class-agnostic MOTChallenge with all GT/tracker class ids set to 1 and DO_PREPROC=False.
TAO export is a supported-subset scaffold, not a dense full-federated TAO TrackEval claim.
Expanded gt/tracker text files are cleaned after each run to avoid quota pressure; manifests preserve row counts and benchmark names.
